label: AI Playground
description: A showcase of what the platform's AI plumbing can actually do: ask questions of a document set and get answers with citations, or benchmark embedding models head-to-head — GPU against CPU — to see which one retrieves better on your own corpus.

model_slots.label: Retrieval embedder
model_slots.note: Embedders are out of the admin panel's scope (it surfaces chat/vision/image only), so this correctly has no RAIL_MODEL_SLOTS counterpart.

notes: The shell overrides this rail's emoji with a real inline SVG via iconOverrides; the emoji here stays the catalog fallback and is what RC003 compares.
Two demos: RAG-over-documents (cited, token-streamed, local⇄NVIDIA-NIM toggle) and the Embedding Lab, which benchmarks embedders across broker/GPU and CPU int8-ONNX on one footing.
Retrieval stays local even when the NIM toggle sends generation to the NVIDIA cloud — that split is deliberate and should not be 'simplified'.
Torch-free rail; the Embedding Lab's onnx assets live on the ai_playground_data volume and are fetched at runtime, not baked into the image.
